 United Tigers are leading the points table.
 By CricTracker Staff Published - 13 Nov 2026, 09:57 IST 
 4 Min Read
 Abu Dhabi T10 League 2026: Match 16, RDC vs UT Match Prediction – Who will win today’s match Royal Desert Champions vs United Tigers? (Source: Instagram) Royal Desert Champions will take on United Tigers in Match No.16 of the Abu Dhabi T10 League 2026 on November 14 at Sheikh Zayed Stadium, Abu Dhabi.
 Royal Desert Champions are at the bottom of the points table with one win from four games. They need to bounce back as quick as possible or else they will be eliminated from the tournament.
 Meanwhile, United Tigers are leading the points table with six points. They are in a comfortable position and will look to maintain that and secure a spot in the summit clash.

 Probable Top Performers from RDC vs UT
 Probable Best Batter: Fakhar Zaman
 Fakhar Zaman might be the key batter in this clash. He has scored 129 runs in four games and scoring at a strike rate above 200. His aggression in the top order will be helpful for the United Tigers to score more runs as quick as possible.
 Probable Best Bowler: Abbas Afridi
 Right-arm pacer Abbas Afridi has taken six wickets in this season so far and will be playing a crucial role with the ball. His pace and variations have been tough to predict and the batters are giving away their wickets cheaply.
